_help: HOW TO UPDATE: Edit the text between the quotes, keep the quotes and commas, and set enabled to true to show an offer. Dates use YYYY-MM-DD. An offer shows only while enabled is true and today falls between start and end (both optional; leave end as an empty string for no expiry). Leave everything disabled to hide the banner and the Current Offers section completely.
